authority_contract: research/stage1_target_label_foundation/stage2_experiment_contract_v1.json (frozen primary metric, baseline roster, stop-condition discipline)
study_question: Do the incumbent seven-layer stack's RECORDED live per-horizon fusion probability triplets carry any predictive information about their attached outcome labels, beyond trivial baselines and chance?

explicitly_not.not_an_admission_packet: PASS here is NOT evidence for decision-path admission. Admission additionally requires an economic study (entry/exit simulation, costs per cost_model_registry_v1, deflated performance) per AGENTS.md decision-path admission.
explicitly_not.not_training: No model is trained, tuned, or selected. The predictions were produced live by the production stack before their outcomes existed (true out-of-sample by construction).
explicitly_not.not_production_wiring: Report-only. No decision-path effect. governance/decision_path_admissions.json is untouched.

data.row_gates: calibration_trust='trusted' AND RTH (time_et.is_rth_ts_utc) AND outcome attached AND fusion available — same gates as calibration.daily_scoreboard
known_lineage_limits: OUTCOME_LINEAGE_NOT_PROVEN: outcome columns carry no writer/mutation lineage (scoreboard v4 standing disclosure)
TIMESTAMP joins for historical rows may be nearest-within-tolerance, not identity; cohorts are reported, never silently pooled
threshold-invalid horizons (per movement_target_threshold) are excluded from trusted scoring and reported as excluded

family.ticker_rule: training-anchor tickers only — guests have thin, heterogeneous coverage and enter later studies explicitly

primary_metric.name: MCC (multiclass Matthews correlation, Gorodkin)
primary_metric.why: frozen by stage2_experiment_contract_v1 for classification targets; robust to flat-majority imbalance that degenerate accuracy hides
advancement_screen_per_cell: day-block bootstrap 95% CI of MCC excludes 0 (B=1000, resample ET dates with replacement)
Holm-Bonferroni adjusted bootstrap p < 0.05 across the declared 12-cell family
accuracy >= always_flat baseline AND accuracy >= majority_class baseline AND accuracy >= persistence baseline
shuffle control MCC CI includes 0 (else STOP: leakage/artifact — investigate before any claim)
primary_metric.no_post_hoc_switching: metric, family, gates, and thresholds are frozen by this file before the run; changing any of them after seeing results invalidates the run

baselines.majority_class: predict the cell's majority truth class
baselines.persistence: predict the previous scored row's truth label (per ticker x horizon, time-ordered)
baselines.shuffle_control: truth labels permuted within cell (K=200, fixed seed) — must score at chance

serial_dependence_honesty.issue: decision rows arrive at ~1-minute cadence while label spans are (N+1) minutes (1c=2m, 5c=6m, 15c=16m, 60c=61m) — adjacent rows share outcome windows and are NOT independent trials
mitigations: day-block bootstrap (resamples whole ET dates, preserving intra-day dependence)
n_independent_windows reported per cell (distinct non-overlapping horizon windows)
EFFECTIVE_SAMPLE_NOT_PROVEN warning carried whenever n_scored > n_independent_windows

sample_floors.below_floor_action: cell reported as UNDER_SAMPLED; excluded from PASS/FAIL claims

stop_conditions: shuffle control significantly above chance in any cell -> STOP (leakage/artifact) before interpreting anything else
zero cells meet sample floors -> report INSUFFICIENT_DATA; no claims

outcome_interpretation.cell_PASS: evidence the recorded fusion signal carries information at that (ticker, horizon) — promotes that cell to the economic study (Study 2: entry/exit + costs)
outcome_interpretation.cell_FAIL: no detectable signal in the recorded predictions for that cell — a real finding that directs search elsewhere (features, horizons, regimes)
outcome_interpretation.global_FAIL: the incumbent stack's recorded outputs carry no detectable edge — the baseline every future challenger must at least reach is chance, and the search moves to new candidates

outputs.authoritative: JSON report; console summary is convenience only
